scope: Actual named-space and project settings owners, typed catalogue creation, current project resolution and complete inherited provenance. A step-settings foundation, not complete project settings inheritance or whole-goal completion.
behavior: ProjectPicker exposes a settings link only for a listed selected project, including an empty shell; the actual route reads that project and checks its project/organization identities.403/404 and explicit inactive mode expose no editor or invented package. URI encoding preserves observed identities with path separators.

Named nonvirtual spaces mount supplied own-scope controls; virtual all and explicit inactive contexts do not. Scope reads verify returned identity and virtual profile. Catalogue membership loss withdraws the entire space, even if old parent content exists.

An explicit mode keeps global definition edit/retire on organization settings. Creation reads actual type choices and submits exact organization/space/project scope and selected type, with no arbitrary scope ID field. Existing exact defaults, pending/write fences and refusal drafts remain. Successful creation rereads catalogue and displays Canonical audit rather than submitted Audit.

Project resolution independently reads the selected actual type or explicit untyped default, retains every via binding and exposes inherited rows read-only. Unlisted choices refuse locally rather than querying an untyped fallback. Definition success refreshes local catalogue and current project resolution. Separate directory/catalogue/resolution reads are observations, not atomic or live permission grants.

Scope-keyed shared editors retire old creation/edit drafts on supplied owner changes. Project, resolution, type and catalogue read fences ignore superseded responses. Real routed metadata faults reach the existing sanitized AppFaultBoundary; the router debug catch no longer intercepts and displays raw messages.
